author: gdb
text:
chatgpt for empowering parents:

olivia was sick much of the time and had never slept through the night. her parents used ChatGPT to prepare questions for her doctors, who identified a rare genetic disorder and later found abnormal brain activity.

with treatment, she’s sick less often and finally sleeps through the night.
